serviceCapacity.source: allocatedMin from flexcar.service_capacities; bookedMin from each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services); service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin only.
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin = modelled minutes available; bookedMin = authoritative booked load from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin = the service_capacities reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until the lot is edited. daily_order_capacity is the UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity'. null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero.
